questions.q_en: How many zeroes are there in the product of 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!?
questions.solution_en:
Since every pair of 2 and 5 gives a zero and in consecutive numbers, multiple of 5 occurs less than multiple of 2, so we need to count only fives.

To find the number of fives in 10*9*8*....*1 we will divide the maximum number (i.e. 10) by 5 and count only quotient i.e. 2.

So, total number of fives in 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6! = (10/5) + (9/5) + (8/5) + (7/5) + (6/5)

= 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1

= 6

Hence, there are six zeroes in 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!.

questions.q_en: A boat takes 7 hours to cover 140 km upstream and 'k - 2' hours to cover 104 km downstream respectively. If the speed of boat in still water is 23 km/h, then the value of 'k' is equal to -
questions.solution_en:
Speed of boat in still water = 23 km/h

Upstream speed = 140/7 = 20 km/h

Then, stream speed = 23 - 20 = 3 km/h

And downstream speed = 23 + 3 = 26 km/h

Now, 26 = 104/(k - 2)

k - 2 = 4

k = 6

questions.q_en: If the slant height of a right pyramid with a square base is 24 m and the total slant surface of the pyramid is 576 m2, then find the ratio of the total slant surface and the area of the base.

576 = 1/2 * 4 * base length of square * 24

Base length of square = 12 m

Total slant surface/ The area of the base = 576/ (12 * 12) = 4: 1

questions.q_en: If (2x - 3y)2 - (2x + y)2 - 2xy = y(ay - bx), then find the value of a + b.
questions.solution_en:
We know, (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

And, (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

Here, (2x - 3y)2 - (2x + y)2 - 2xy = y(ay - bx)

(4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy) - (4x2 + y2 + 4xy) - 2xy = ay2 - bxy

4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy - 4x2 - y2 - 4xy - 2xy = ay2 - bxy

8y2 - 18xy = ay2 - bxy

Comparing coefficients of y2 and xy in the above equation we get

a = 8, b = 18

Therefore, a + b = 8 + 18 = 26

Volume of three spheres =3 X 4/3 X π X r3 = 3 X 4/3 X π X 13

Volume of two hemi-spheres =2 X 2/3 X π X r3 =2 X 2/3 X π X 23

Volume of a cylinder =π X r2 X h = π X 22 X h

Now, Volume of the hemi-spheres and spheres is equal to the volume of the cylinder.

On solving, we get that the height of the cylinder is 2.66cm.

questions.q_en: The perimeter of a square is 2.2 m. If side of the square is 15 cm less than the length of the rectangle and is 5 cm more than the breadth of the rectangle, then what is the perimeter of the rectangle (in m)?
questions.solution_en:
The perimeter of a square is 2.2 m

=> 4 * side = 2.2 * 100

=> side = 55 cm

So, length = 55 + 15 = 70 cm

And breadth = 55 - 5 = 50 cm

So, perimeter of the rectangle = 2(70 + 50) = 240 cm = 2.4 m

questions.q_en: In the production of car three types of cost are involved. Cost of raw materials, expenditure on labour and miscellaneous costs. Ratio of expenditure on these costs in a particular year is 4 : 3 : 2 respectively. In the next year cost of raw material increased by 10%, expenditure on labour increased by 8% and miscellaneous cost decreased by 5%. Find the percentage rise in the cost of car?
questions.solution_en:
Cost of raw material = 4x

Expenditure costs = 3x

Miscellaneous costs = 2x

Total cost = 4x + 3x + 2x = 9x

Amount = (4x * 110) / 100 + (3x * 108) / 100 + (2x * 95) / 100

= 9.54x

Percentage rise = (9.54x - 9x) / 9x * 100 = 6%
